title: Condenser structured JSONL logging and thinking token fix
description: Skills extraction silently fails. Qwen returns <think>...</think> reasoning blocks before JSON, breaking the regex extraction. No persistent log exists — all condenser output goes to stderr. Fix: (1) Strip <think> tokens before JSON extraction in _llm_name_skill(), (2) Add structured JSONL logger at ~/.ix/voyage/voyage-condenser.log with entries for analyze_graph, LLM calls, skill writes, and round summaries.
definition-of-done: 1. _llm_name_skill() strips <think>...</think> before JSON regex. 2. JSONL log file at ~/.ix/voyage/voyage-condenser.log. 3. Log entries for: analyze_graph success/failure, LLM response (full text on failure), skill write, round summary. 4. condense_winner logs entry and exit with skill count.
testing-plan: 1. Run a voyage round with condenser. 2. Check ~/.ix/voyage/voyage-condenser.log for JSONL entries. 3. Verify skills are named and written. 4. Simulate <think> token in LLM response — verify JSON still extracted.
